title: 第447章 圣子大人我们来帮你第446章 白尊出手
slug: 谁让这小子升执法长老的
content_zh:
丹峰弟子这次没敢喊稳了。
因为他们看得清楚。
曹立接住了。
以八品天尊大圆满，硬接圣子九品大圆满一击，只退了三丈。
白尊掌心微微发麻，他看着曹立，心里那股不甘反而变得更重。
这家伙真的能接住。
曹立甩了一下手。“有点东西。”
白尊眉头压下。“再来。”
雪花大道再次旋转，分出数十道雪刃，从不同方向斩向曹立。
曹立脚下金光一闪，人已经冲了出去。
他没有躲远，反而直奔白尊。
雪刃落到他身边，被七彩莲一片片扫开。
有几道穿过莲光，划开他的衣袍，血飞出来，可曹立速度没慢。
白尊抬掌，寒霜凝成一道掌印。
曹立挥拳。
砰！
掌印碎开。
他贴到白尊面前，一拳砸向白尊胸口，白尊双臂交叉，雪花大道回旋护身。
砰！
白尊被打得退了两步。

丹峰弟子心脏都跟着跳了一下。
“圣子被打退了？”
“曹立也太猛了吧，这可是圣子啊！”
白尊手臂发沉，他没有怒吼，也没有退开，反倒主动往前压，雪花大道贴着他的身躯转动，寒意集中到掌心。
下一瞬，两人同时出手。
白尊的雪花大道从上方切下，曹立的七彩莲从下方砸起。
轰！
整条山道被余波掀开一层。
三名八品天尊站在后面，本来还想看圣子单独镇压曹立。
可这一碰之后，三人脸色全变了，曹立没有被压下去。
他还能跟白尊对攻。
八品中期长老咬了咬牙。“不行。”
另一人看向他。“你想干什么？”
八品中期长老压低嗓子。“圣子大人说保我们，我们总不能站着看。”
第三人迟疑了一下。“圣子和曹立的修为那么高，我们能插手进去吗……”
八品中期长老直接打断。“管不了那么多了，能帮一点是一点。”
那人顿时不吭声了。
三人互相看了一眼，丹火再次升起。
半空中，白尊一掌逼退曹立半步，正要继续压上。
就在这时，三道丹火从侧面冲了上来。
content_en:
The Danfeng disciples did not dare to shout "Sure" this time.
Because they can see clearly.
Cao Li caught it.
With the eighth-grade Tianzun Dzogchen, he directly received the ninth-grade Dzogchen blow from the Holy Son, and only retreated three feet.
Bai Zun's palms were slightly numb. He looked at Cao Li, and the unwillingness in his heart became heavier.
This guy can really catch it.
Cao Li shook his hand. "Something."
Bai Zun lowered his brows. "Come again."
The avenue of snowflakes spun again, splitting out dozens of snow blades and slashing at Cao Li from different directions.
The golden light flashed under Cao Li's feet, and he had already rushed out.
He did not hide away, but went straight to Bai Zun.
The snow blade fell next to him and was swept away by the colorful lotus.
Several rays passed through the lotus light and cut open his robe, and blood flew out, but Cao Li did not slow down.
Bai Zun raised his palm, and the frost formed a palm print.
Cao Li punched.
Bang!
The palm prints shattered.
He stood in front of Bai Zun and punched Bai Zun in the chest. Bai Zun crossed his arms and spun around to protect himself.
Bang!
Bai Zun was beaten and took two steps back.
The Danfeng disciple's heart skipped a beat.
"The Holy Son was beaten back?"
"Cao Li is too fierce, this is the Holy Son!"
Bai Zun's arms felt heavy. He didn't roar or move away. Instead, he actively pressed forward. Snowflake Avenue rotated against his body, and the chill concentrated in his palms.
The next moment, the two of them took action at the same time.
Bai Zun's snowflake avenue was cut from above, and Cao Li's colorful lotus was smashed from below.
boom!
The entire mountain road was lifted by the aftermath.
Three eighth-grade Tianzun stood behind. They originally wanted to watch the Holy Son suppress Cao Li alone.
But after this touch, the expressions of the three people all changed, and Cao Li was not suppressed.
He can also fight against Bai Zun.
The mid-eighth-grade elder gritted his teeth. "No."
The other person looked at him. "What do you want to do?"
The mid-eighth grade elder lowered his voice. "The Holy Son said he would protect us, but we can't just stand and watch."
The third person hesitated. "The cultivation of Shengzi and Cao Li is so high, can we get involved..."
The middle-level eighth-grade elder interrupted directly. "I can't control that much. I can help a little bit."
The man suddenly fell silent.
The three of them looked at each other, and the elixir fire rose again.
In mid-air, Bai Zun forced Cao Li back half a step with a palm, and was about to continue pressing on him.
At this moment, three rays of pill fire rushed up from the side.
